text: Richard Barrera, running for California Superintendent of Public Instruction, has not called the war in Gaza a genocide or spoken against U.S. military aid to Israel. What his record does show is a sharp contrast with Sonja Shaw. At a May 2026 state-superintendent forum, Barrera raised concerns about how AB 715, the state antisemitism education law, plays out in classrooms, saying he would defend it when it protects students but declining to commit to defending it against every lawsuit. Shaw, at that same forum, pressed for stronger enforcement and accused Barrera of weakening an antisemitism resolution. Shaw also refused in March 2024, as Chino Valley school board president, to let a pro-Palestinian group address her board while other boards passed ceasefire resolutions, and she appeared on Fox News in December 2023 framing the Israel-Gaza conflict primarily through antisemitism concerns. CAIR Action lists Barrera as preferred; Vote for Peace marks Shaw as Opposed. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorses Barrera, while a full slate of California Republican organizations endorses Shaw.
